# Late Yashwantrao Chavan Smruti Bhavan (स्व. यशवंतराव चव्हाण स्मृती भवन)

> Memorial to Yashwantrao Chavan — freedom fighter, first Chief Minister of Maharashtra and former Deputy Prime Minister of India — built by Yashwantrao Chavan Smarak Samiti, Pimpri-Chinchwad, at Sector 27A, near Sant Tukaram Udyan, Pradhikaran, Nigdi, Pune 411044.

## Key facts
- Samiti founded: 1989 (registered under the Bombay Public Trusts Act, 1950)
- Land: 44 gunthe at Pradhikaran, Nigdi, acquired 1991
- Construction: started 2014, completed September 2026
- Built-up area: 1.5 lakh sq ft
- 15 ft full statue of Yashwantrao Chavan — described as his tallest statue in India
- Late Venutai Chavan multipurpose halls: 1200 seats and 350 seats, both air-conditioned; dining hall for 400; 8 AC guest rooms
- Student hostel: 52 rooms, capacity 144 students
- Late Arun Kirloskar UPSC/MPSC study room and library
- Late Shrimant Chh. Abhaysinhraje Bhosale history library
- Late Hirabai Kisanrao Landge student guidance centre
- Paschim Maharashtra Vadhu-Var Suchak Kendra (matchmaking centre)
- Yashwantrao Chavan life-story gallery (Jeevanpat)

## Contact
- Phone: +91 9763312447, +91 9665501501, +91 9860490867
- Hall booking: https://venutaihall.com/
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=13691449001336773566
